name: Lion's Breath (Simhasana)
equipment: A quiet space, kneeling or seated
instructions: Kneel or sit comfortably, placing your hands on your knees with fingers spread wide.
Inhale deeply through your nose, letting your belly fill with air.
Open your mouth wide, stick your tongue out and down toward your chin, and open your eyes wide.
Exhale forcefully through your mouth with an audible "ha" sound, from deep in your belly.
Relax your face and breathe normally for a moment, then repeat for 3 rounds.
